info.title: Remembrances MCP HTTP API
info.description:
HTTP surface of the Remembrances MCP server.

This document is generated from the route registrations (`internal/transport`),
not written by hand, and a test fails the build when a registered route has no
operation or an operation has no registered route.

Three listeners exist and they are separate:

- the HTTP JSON API (`--http`, :8080 by default) serves /health and the
  /mcp/tools placeholder endpoints of this document;
- the MCP Streamable HTTP transport (`--mcp-http`, :3000 by default) serves the
  /mcp endpoint, which is the real MCP surface and is described here as an
  external operation because an embedded library serves it;
- module routes are registered on the HTTP JSON API listener, under the base
  path each module declares, and appear here only in a build that includes
  those modules.

Authentication: module routes are behind the module authentication layer when a
module provides one. Alchemai Mem provides `Authorization: Bearer <Control JWT>`,
verified against Control's JWKS with iss, aud=alchemai and exp checks; the
claims become the storage principal (see RM-2 and RM-10). The core routes of
this document carry no authentication of their own.

get.description: Returns 200 with {"status":"ok"} while the process is serving. It does not check the datastore, so it is a liveness probe and not a readiness one.

405.description: The path is served but not for this method; the Allow header lists the methods that are

delete.description: Terminates the session named by the Mcp-Session-Id header.

get.summary: Open the server to client SSE stream
get.description: Opens the server-initiated event stream of a stateful MCP session. Requires the Mcp-Session-Id header returned by initialize.

post.summary: Send a JSON-RPC message to the MCP server
post.description: The MCP Streamable HTTP binding. The body is a JSON-RPC 2.0 request; the response is either a JSON-RPC response or an SSE stream, depending on the Accept header. Served by the embedded go-mcp transport on the --mcp-http listener, not by the HTTP JSON API listener.

get.summary: List the tools of the HTTP JSON API
get.description: Lists the tools this JSON API exposes. It is not the MCP tool list: the MCP surface is served by the Streamable HTTP transport, and this endpoint answers with the placeholder set the JSON API implements today.

options.description: Answers the browser preflight with the Access-Control-Allow-* headers the handler sets. The JSON API allows every origin.

post.summary: Call a tool over the HTTP JSON API
post.description: Accepts an MCP CallToolRequest body. The JSON API does not yet reach the MCP tool registry, so the reply is a placeholder result; use the MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint for real tool calls.
